data_issues: 9 of 33 neurons (indices [2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 14, 18, 23, 27]) are all zero on every test trial, but fire normally in train/val (e.g. unit 27 averages ~15 spikes, unit 18 ~15, unit 5 ~15, unit 14 ~11). These look like dead or dropped channels in the test split, and they include the most category-selective units. Decoder was trained on the 24 remaining neurons only. A model using them would see impossible zeros at test time. Labels match the category field in train/val; no duplicates or train/test overlap.
